title: KCP space_participant_activate result (DESIGN.md §10.2, §11.6.1 activation family)
description: CommandResult.result payload for space_participant_activate (§11.2 ok arm; the envelope's revision/event_cursor members live outside this payload). The activated SpaceParticipant projection (gap notes KG4/KG19).

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

participantKind.description: Closed SpaceParticipant.kind enum, verbatim §10.2 (§11.8: closed); a peer projection can never act as a local actor (§10.2).

participantRole.description: Closed SpaceParticipant.role enum, verbatim §10.2 (§11.8: closed); participation supplies addressability and role presentation, not authority (§10.2).

participantStatus.description: Closed SpaceParticipant.status enum, verbatim §10.2 (§11.8: closed); activation and removal transitions have their own operations (gap note KG19).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

spaceParticipant.description: SpaceParticipant projection, field names verbatim from the §10.2 record shape (gap notes KG4/KG19).
